rows.corpus_definition: decorated in a showy or unusual way; imaginative

rows.corpus_definition: Extremely interesting and capturing your attention.

rows.corpus_definition: causing death or having very serious, unrecoverable results

rows.corpus_definition: A large meal with many types of food.

rows.corpus_definition: Relating to the central government of a whole country.

rows.corpus_definition: Anything relating to the management of money.

rows.corpus_definition: The hand with all fingers held tightly inside.
